name: algorithm-reach-mechanics
definition: How the platform's distribution system works and the in-app settings/levers that unlock reach, views, or audience quality. The subject is the algorithm or account/privacy settings themselves — not your profile shell (use profile-and-posting-setup) or your follower-count playbook (use growth-and-virality). Tie-break: if the reel is mainly 'change THIS setting / exploit THIS platform behavior to get more reach,' it belongs here.
signals: Instagram cheat code / new IG update
never turn on these privacy settings

name: hooks-and-scripting
definition: Crafting the opening hook and the line-by-line script: written/verbal/visual hooks, weak-vs-viral hook comparisons, reusable hook templates, retention/script structure. The subject is the words and their framing. Tie-break: if the core teaching is 'say it like THIS in the first 3 seconds / structure your script this way,' it goes here, even if AI generates it.
signals: bad hook vs good hook vs great hook
100 view hook vs 1 million view hook

name: editing-and-production
definition: Physical production craft: editing/cutting, camera, lighting, background, sound design, captions, safe zones, music selection, and recording technique on camera. Equipment and edit execution. Tie-break: if the lesson is about HOW the video is shot, cut, lit, captioned, or scored, it goes here.
signals: sound effects / background songs / trending audio
$6,000 camera vs iPhone / equipment list / GEAR
recording process / be more natural on camera

name: content-strategy-and-planning
definition: Deciding WHAT to post at a system level: content types and the value funnel (TOFU/MOFU/BOFU), formats, niche-to-format mapping, content pillars/series, and batch-planning a month of content. Higher-altitude than a single hook or edit. Tie-break: if it's about the mix/system of content rather than one video's hook, edit, or distribution, it goes here.
signals: 5 types of content you should post
TOFU MOFU BOFU / top middle bottom of funnel
month of content in 60 minutes / batching

name: modeling-and-research
definition: Finding, studying, and replicating what already works: locating viral outlier videos, transcribing/saving/organizing competitor content, and cloning a proven video's format/template onto your niche. Tools used purely to research or copy winners live here. Tie-break: if the action is 'find / study / steal / clone an existing winner,' it goes here rather than in strategy or growth.
signals: copy any video / clone the format
templatize the viral video / steal my template
save 100 videos over a million views / study their structures

name: ai-tools-and-commentary
definition: AI itself as the subject: comparing or recommending specific tools/LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Lovable, Codex), and opinion/risk/capability commentary about AI's impact. NOT the routine use of AI to write a hook or script (that goes to the relevant craft category). Tie-break: if the reel argues about WHICH AI or what AI MEANS, it goes here; if AI is just the tool executing a content task, classify by the task.
signals: which AI tool / guess the AI tool
why I switched to Claude / ChatGPT is dying
AI will replace / AI is the future
polyamorous with AIs / large language model

name: monetization-and-clients
definition: Turning attention into money: getting clients/leads, offers, funnels, paid ads, lead magnets, VSLs, DM/comment-to-offer flows, sales scripts, and cold outbound. Tie-break: if the payoff is revenue, leads, or closing clients, it goes here even when AI, ads, or a viral video is the vehicle.
signals: comment SMM / comment WORD to get
get clients / leads / one client today
meta ads / post ID ad / landing pages
mini VSL / lead magnet / sales script
cold outbound / story to turn followers into clients

name: growth-and-virality
definition: Playbooks for follower growth and getting/leveraging a viral video as an outcome: zero-to-X follower journeys, doubling down on a winner, cross-platform follower value, and posting volume as a growth lever. Tie-break: outcome is followers or a viral hit (the destination); if the reel teaches a specific edit, hook, setting, or research tactic (the method), classify there instead.
signals: zero to a million followers / first viral video
slow growth vs fast growth posting schedule
double down on your viral video

name: profile-and-posting-setup
definition: Optimizing the static profile shell and where/when content is placed: highlights, pinned posts, bio, keywords-as-text, and cadence/placement by format (stories vs carousels vs reels, how often). Tie-break: this is the profile container and schedule; the platform's distribution levers belong to algorithm-reach-mechanics, and the content mix belongs to content-strategy-and-planning.
signals: add keywords as text / hidden keywords
stories 3x week, reels 5x week / posting schedule

name: personal-brand-and-positioning
definition: Building a recognizable on-camera identity and authority: one consistent face, following-vs-brand, speaking presence as positioning (not recording mechanics), authority signals, and the team behind the brand. Tie-break: if the subject is WHO is on screen and their credibility/positioning, it goes here; if it's how to physically record/perform, use editing-and-production.
signals: building a following vs personal brand
one consistent person / face of the brand

name: niche-and-business-model-selection
definition: Choosing or rating a niche or business/money-making model by viability: saturation, difficulty, opportunity, and cash-or-pass verdicts on niches or income paths. Tie-break: if the reel ranks/judges WHICH niche or business to pick, it goes here, even when AI or content is one of the options.
signals: cash or pass / niche rating out of 10
real estate cash, drop shipping pass
best business model / which niche to pick

name: mindset-and-business-philosophy
definition: Entrepreneurial mindset and broad opinion content not tied to content mechanics: work ethic, leadership/decision-making, money/investing philosophy, life/education/parenting takes, podcast-style hot takes. Tie-break: the catch-all for opinion/identity content with no actionable content-marketing tactic; if a concrete posting, editing, hook, or monetization tactic is present, classify there.
signals: hard times make strong men / Gen Z fragile
manager vs leader / praise the process not the win
$50 to fix it rule / pay for speed
real estate is how millionaires are made
